name: Farjana Reading Progress Bar
author: farjanaplugin

sections.description:
A professional and lightweight plugin to enhance user experience on your blog. This plugin shows a real-time progress bar as the user scrolls and displays an estimated reading time.

Key Features

  • Real-time Scroll Progress: A smooth progress bar at the top or bottom of the screen.
  • Estimated Reading Time: Automatically calculates reading time based on word count.
  • Glassmorphism Design: Modern, blurred background style for the reading time box.
  • Fully Customizable: Change colors, font size, icons, and position from the admin panel.
  • Shortcode Support: Use [reading_time] to display the reading time anywhere.
  • Highly Lightweight: Minimal impact on site loading speed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the farjana-reading-progress-bar folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the .zip file via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Farjana Reading Time to customize the appearance and behavior.
sections.faq:
Does it work with custom post types?

Yes, you can enable it for any public post type (like Posts, Pages, or Portfolio) from the settings page.

Can I use it inside the post content manually?

Yes, simply use the [reading_time] shortcode in your Gutenberg editor or any text widget.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The design is fully responsive and looks great on all devices.
